scaling_contract.standard_overclock: while recipePower<inputMin and recipePower*4<=inputMax: recipePower*=4; progressRequirement*=2
scaling_contract.cheap_overclock: skip the standard overclock loop; selected three-machine rows do not enable cheap overclock
scaling_contract.parallel_duration: outputs and input consumption multiply by selected parallel count; progressRequirement also multiplies by that count
scaling_contract.efficiency: progressRequirement uses the source efficiency divisor; selected rows use the fixed default 10000

failure_outcomes.recipe_over_window: NO_RECIPE_MATCH: findRecipe receives inputMax as its power ceiling.
failure_outcomes.packet_overvoltage: OVERCHARGE: doInject calls overcharge when packet size exceeds inputMax.
failure_outcomes.underpowered: STOPPED_OR_IDLE: progress does not advance unless stored energy reaches both inputMin and recipe minimum energy.
failure_outcomes.output_blocked: STALLED: recipe start is refused when canOutput is zero, or completed progress is held at max while pending outputs remain.
